Kavya Rao: Quick weekly ledger-signal checkin — hosted spend vs commit for the week. Topline: 2 accounts flagged for overage, 1 account high error-rate for embeddings. Details below.
spend-alert-bot: Alert: ACME-Corp exceeded 85% of monthly commit in 5 days. spike=+220% vs baseline. link: https://console.redwood.ai/commits/ACME-Corp
Miguel Santos: Thanks, Kavya. Which routes/models are driving ACME's spike?
Kavya Rao: Mostly text-generation (gpt-like-open) on /v1/generate, lots of streaming sessions. Sample query from alertql: `SELECT account, sum(tokens) FROM events WHERE account='ACME-Corp' AND ts > now() - interval '7d' GROUP BY account;`
Samir Patel: Hmm latency bump correlated? I see a 99th pct increase for ACME on our latency dashboard — could be prefix caching not kicking in.
Jules Tran: I can reach out to their onboarding lead for a quick prompt-engineering session. Any notable error types?
Kavya Rao: Errors mostly 429 rate-limited and some 5xx from runtime. For the 5xx, trace id sample: `trace_202403_7c9` — assigned to eng-runtime for triage.
spend-alert-bot: Flag created: #ANOM-2440001234 -> channel:eng-runtime, severity:high
Miguel Santos: @Samir can you take runtime triage? I'll prepare a short explainer for ACME on batching and streaming limits.
Samir Patel: On it. I'll post findings in eng-runtime and tag here. ETA 2 hours.
Jules Tran: I'll book a 30m enablement call for ACME tomorrow afternoon and prep a short playbook on caching + rate controls.
Kavya Rao: Action items: (1) Samir triage runtime 5xx + latency, (2) Miguel prepare batching guidance, (3) Jules schedule enablement + follow up, (4) Billing to propose temporary burst cap for ACME to avoid immediate cutoff. @billing-team any volunteer?
spend-alert-bot: Billing assign request sent to billing-ops.
Miguel Santos: I'll draft the burst cap proposal; Kavya can you include commit vs forecast chart? Need it for the customer-facing note.
Kavya Rao: Will attach chart in thread when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: quick note — if ACME is running long sequences, recommend quantized model variant and prefix cache; I'll include impact numbers.
spend-alert-bot: Thread closed for workspace actions. (automated summary will be added to account health doc)
